d:
If you want to see Rhino in the wild in India, there are just 3 national parks, Assam, West Bengal & UP. For many Uttar Pradesh may come as as suprise.
We spotted many Rhino's in Dhudhwa national park, got chance to see Tiger there. During our visit to Pilibhit Tiger reserve we got chance to see 3 Tigers from little long distance but that was a moment in itself.
